object: Russian shortened cuirassier and dragoon pistol, 1798/1804 pattern
prototype: Tula 1803; Museum of Russian Military History, Padikovo
method: M.C.M.T exterior analysis; manually authored reconstruction, not photogrammetry

materials.name: wood
materials.texture: subtle longitudinal grain, muted brown finished birch
materials.certainty: birch and brown finish documented for base pattern; exact museum finish unmeasured

materials.name: steel
materials.texture: subtle processing striations and tonal patina

materials.name: lock
materials.texture: uniform neutral iron; no artificial ageing

components.name: WoodStock
components.geometry: photo-profile loft with densely sampled grip curves, fore-end undercut and integral shallow carved border relief

components.name: Barrel
components.geometry: revised rear exterior taper seated in photo-profile stock; closed display-only recess retained

components.name: LockPlate
components.geometry: interpolating photo contour with defined rear tip and lower edge, seated on wood

components.name: Cock and Frizzen
components.geometry: photo-contour exterior sculpture; rounded waisted upper head around an inclined axis, clipped open slot with walls and floor, integral exposed stem relief, faceted collar, layered shoulders and tapered leaves
components.inferred: depths and cross-sections; no internal or moving mechanism

components.name: Pan
components.geometry: rounded tapering shallow exterior bowl with raised back; no internal passage

components.name: Counterplate
components.geometry: serpentine seated plate and three heads

components.name: Ramrod
components.geometry: separate wooden shaft and tapered brass head through two hollow faceted pipes with stock mounts

components.name: ButtCap
components.geometry: conforming photo-traced side plates with long ears and rounded lower return

notReconstructed: working kinetics, ignition and functional fastener alignment

textures.wear: lock: uniform neutral iron, no artificial oxidation or pits; wood unchanged

uncertainty: overall length about 460 mm is assumed

photoRegistration.left: rigid camera roll 0.015 radians; centerY 507.5 photo pixels; inverse mapping shared by counterplate
photoRegistration.closeUp: fixed affine registration of the museum detail to right photo
photoRegistration.qualification: manual image registration, not a calibrated measurement
